name: Password Entry to Recovery Request
summary: The anonymous user selects Forgot Password from password sign-in and opens the password recovery request view.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and auth.continue.email.password is visible

postconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and auth.password.reset.request is visible

sourceReferences.note: Shared client-only entry scenario for both Password Recovery Success and Password Recovery Rejected.
